dataset.description: The Gold Barometer monthly gold buying-conditions scores, reconstructed point-in-time back to January 1971 using only data available at each date. The overall score and the part score of each measured component. Scores from 0 to 100. Zones: 0-19 historically very unfavorable, 20-39 unfavorable, 40-59 mixed, 60-79 favorable, 80-100 historically very favorable.

INDICATOR.REAL_RATES: Cash yield after inflation, part score
INDICATOR.STRUCTURAL_DEMAND: Central bank and fund demand, part score
